positions.name: Applied Materials
positions.catalyst: Q2 5/14 AMC: EPS $2.86 vs $2.68 est; rev $7.91B vs $7.69B. Q3 guide $8.95B rev / $3.36 EPS smashes Street. 2026 semi-equip industry growth lifted to >30% from >20%. Margins at 25-yr high on AI/HBM/DRAM demand. +5% AH, +1.5% pre-mkt today.
positions.risks: AI-capex over-extension narrative; gap-and-fade risk if broader semis weak; Friday-into-weekend profit-taking.
positions.driver: Beat-and-raise on the most-watched semi-equipment print of the season; Citi raised PT; sell-side chase setup.

positions.name: Papa John's International
positions.catalyst: Bajco Group (largest US franchisee, ~10% of stores) joining Irth Capital's $47/share take-private bid (Reuters, 5/14 AH). Implies ~32% headline premium to current. +7% pre-market.
positions.risks: Board may reject; deal financing/regulatory uncertainty; weak same-store sales backdrop; pure deal-spread arb on a non-binding bid.
positions.driver: Fresh M&A catalyst with credible bidder coalition; deal-arb chase trade.
